sections.Profile:
"Action" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company in September 1969.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1969
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Racing, Sports, Original Theme, Pointy People, Cars, Single level playfield
